blocks.text: There was a time when youth was something to be chased visibly: lifted cheekbones, plumped lips, a kind of beauty that made its presence known the moment you entered a room. But today, the most coveted aesthetic is far more elusive. It doesn’t announce itself. It lingers, intrigues, and leaves people wondering. A look of freshness in the face. Radiance that looks effortlessly well. Naysayers suspect a treatment, but perhaps it could be a new health kick. Maybe more hours of sleep. “You want something that suits your lifestyle and your skin needs,” shared Dr. Jennie Diaz-Francisco. “It’s no longer one-size-fits-all. […]...
